dc_eval_autonomy.quote: We evaluate Grok 4.5 on its ability to automate parts of the engineering and research process for training and evaluating new versions of itself.

dc_eval_persuasion.note: no persuasion/manipulation evaluation; epistemic bias and sycophancy are not influence-operation evals
